shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone surface
register-like horizontal division of the surface
quadruped with four legs in profile
repeated row of similar figures/motifs along a band
justification: Both surfaces carry low relief organised into horizontal bands with profile animals and repeated motifs, which is about as generic a correspondence as relief carving allows. A shows schematic, disembodied and highly abstracted creatures (crouching quadrupeds, snake-like and bird-like forms, arch-like shapes) with no human actors or narrative, while B shows a naturalistic procession of robed human figures with drinking vessels and a horse-drawn wheeled chariot beneath a stepped crenellation and rosette borders — different subject matter and utterly different rendering conventions.
